# pve_realm_sync_job (Resource)

Realm-sync job syncing users/groups from an auth domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_realm_sync_job" "example" {
  item_id  = "CHANGE_ME"
  schedule = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (String) The ID of the job.
- `schedule` (String) Backup schedule. The format is a subset of `systemd` calendar events.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Description for the Job.
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `enable_new` (Boolean) Enable newly synced users immediately. (default: 1)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Determines if the job is enabled. (default: 1)
- `realm` (String) Authentication domain ID
- `remove_vanished` (String) A semicolon-separated list of things to remove when they or the user vanishes during a sync. The following values are possible: 'entry' removes the user/group when not returned from the sync. 'properties' removes the set properties on existing user/group that do not appear in the source (even custom ones). 'acl' removes acls when the user/group is not returned from the sync. Instead of a list it also can be 'none' (the default). (default: none)
- `scope` (String) Select what to sync. One of: `users`, `groups`, `both`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: item_id (also the `terraform import` format).
